snippet.title: Grim Trials | Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
It's time to enter the Afterlife in heavy metal style.

As announced in Convergence Showcase, Grim Trials will launch on August 20, 2026 on PC, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5, and Nintendo Switch & Switch 2! 

Wishlist on: 
Steam ➡️ https://bit.ly/GrimTrialsSteam
Xbox ➡️ https://bit.ly/GrimTrialsXbox
Nintendo Switch 2 ➡️ https://bit.ly/GrimTrialsNS2

Nintendo Switch 2 preorder ➡️ https://bit.ly/GrimTrialsNS2

Play the demo NOW:
Steam: https://bit.ly/GrimTrialsDemo
Nintendo Switch 2: https://bit.ly/GrimTrialsNS2
Xbox: https://bit.ly/GrimTrialsXbox
